categories.name: Product Fit And Identity
checks: visual identity fits current project type
strong themes avoid first genre cliche
source-project influence is evidence, not template

categories.name: Primary Object And Action
checks: primary object visible in first viewport
page title does not replace object

categories.name: Interaction Grammar
checks: hover focus active selected states exist
disabled and loading states avoid layout shift

categories.name: Layout And Composition
checks: desktop uses width for useful context
no text badge control or image collision
hierarchy works without reading every label

categories.name: Responsive Evidence
checks: 390 has no clipping or horizontal scroll
768 is not broken mobile or cramped desktop

categories.name: Copy And Data Truth
checks: helper copy changes decision or explains state
claims include source recency scope or fallback

categories.name: Component Completeness
checks: tags chips tabs have distinct roles
rows cards drawers match object model
focus visible and accessible names exist

categories.name: Asset And Motion Use
checks: no generic AI or SaaS decoration

skippedVisualConceptGate.description: Visual-heavy work skipped the 3 rendered-concept Visual Concept Gate.

textOnlyConcepts.description: Visual-heavy work produced text-only concepts instead of rendered previews.

approvalWithoutVisualPreviews.description: Migi was asked to approve art direction without visual previews.

missingConceptScreenshots.description: Concept screenshot paths are missing for the Visual Concept Gate.

sameConceptLayout.description: All three concepts share basically the same layout.

implementationBeforeConceptApproval.description: Implementation began before Migi approved one rendered visual concept.

referenceFlattening.description: Reference was reduced to shallow traits such as dark, neon, cards, or glow.

sameLayoutWithNewPaint.description: Rejected structure was kept while only styling changed.

genericLayoutInsteadOfReference.description: A strong reference was replaced by generic app layout.

primaryObjectReplacedByGrid.description: Primary object in the reference or concept was replaced by grid/cards/dashboard.

overlapCollision.description: Visible UI elements overlap or collide unintentionally.

decorativeMotionWithoutPurpose.description: Animation does not clarify state, interaction, hierarchy, or feedback.

aiScaleInflation.description: Oversized AI-app typography or containers overwhelm the product.

obviousThemeCliche.description: Design follows the obvious genre route without a fresh thesis.

selectionFirstNoDesire.description: Selection-first product does not make objects desirable to click.

badgeGlowStatsAsExcitement.description: Excitement is created mainly through badges, glows, or stats.
